primary.body:
## Context
PR #11 was merged before these two commits were pushed to the same branch, so they never made it into that PR. This is a fresh PR for just those two commits, diffed against current `main`.

## Summary
App-layer production-readiness items, worked through as a go-live checklist before moving to infra:

- **Error handling** — `error.tsx`/`global-error.tsx`/`not-found.tsx` didn't exist at all before this; a real bug in front of a real client showed Next.js's bare default screen.
- **Name collected at signup** — wired to `profiles.display_name` via the existing `handle_new_user_profile` trigger. Previously defaulted silently to the email's local part.
- **Duplicate-email signup handled explicitly** — matches Supabase's explicit "already registered" error, and separately the anti-enumeration case (confirmed existing user re-signing up returns success with an empty identities array, not an error) — the old generic "check your email" message was actively misleading in that second case.
- **Change password while logged in** — new `/dashboard/account` page, `supabase.auth.updateUser`, same call the reset-password flow already used.
- **Rate limiting on `forgot-password`** — in-memory sliding-window limiter, 3 requests/15min, keyed by submitted email. Flagged in-code for when it needs to become a shared store (horizontal scaling).
- `BACKLOG.md` updated to record all of the above.

## Testing
All five flows verified live against the real dev Supabase project (not just build-level): name → `display_name`, a fresh real signup, a duplicate-signup attempt against a real confirmed account, the error/not-found boundaries, and a full change-password round trip (changed and immediately reverted, so the e2e suite's stored credential stays valid). `tsc`, `eslint`, unit tests, and `next build` all pass.
